subpages.text: Connectivity and Component, Equipment, Plastic and Miscellaneous Homepage Connectivity and Component Equipment and Machinery Lubricants and Misc Homepage > Connectivity and Component > Centec Networks Search site Search: Centec Networks (Suzhou) Centec Networks is founded in Suzhou industrial park, January 2005. It has been focusing on Ethernet switch silicon and SDN whitebox solutions for over 12 years. Since foundation, Centec has developed 5 generations of switch chips which has been widely used in carrier, enterprise and data center networks globally. Leveraging a high-performance open SDN architecture, Centec enables seamless migration from the traditional L2, L3 and MPLS/MPLS-TP architecture to the new SDN era while solving some of SDN’s biggest challenges. Centec and its customers are redefining the future of network switching. The Ethernet switching silicon product part number of Centec is list below: CT5160, CT8096 and CT7148.
